world-gdrive-sync.sharedWorlds.title: Shared Worlds
world-gdrive-sync.sharedWorlds.connectFi: Connect the group's shared Google account first. Open settings (the gear button) and press Connect Google.
world-gdrive-sync.sharedWorlds.empty: No Shared Worlds yet. Share one of your worlds to start.
world-gdrive-sync.play.title: Starting %s
world-gdrive-sync.play.refused.title: Someone Is Hosting
world-gdrive-sync.play.refused: %s is hosted by %s right now. Join them through Essential, or wait until they save and quit.
world-gdrive-sync.takeOver.title: Stale Lock
world-gdrive-sync.takeOver.message:
%s is still locked by %s, but their game hasn't checked in for %s. They may have crashed or lost their connection.

Take Over and host it yourself, or Wait for them to come back and save properly?
world-gdrive-sync.takeOver.warning.title: Take Over?
world-gdrive-sync.takeOver.warning: Any progress %s made since their last upload may be lost. You will start from the Current Save in Google Drive, as of their last upload.
world-gdrive-sync.heartbeat.lockLost: A friend Took Over this Shared World. Your progress won't be uploaded over theirs; it stays on this computer and becomes an Unmerged Backup the next time you play.
world-gdrive-sync.play.unmerged.title: Your Progress Is in Backups
world-gdrive-sync.play.unmerged: Someone Took Over %s and uploaded a newer world while your progress from your last session wasn't uploaded yet. Your progress was kept as an Unmerged Backup with your name (see Backups), and you now continue from the newer world.
world-gdrive-sync.retry.unmerged: Someone Took Over %s and uploaded a newer world, so your Pending Upload wasn't uploaded over it. It was kept as an Unmerged Backup with your name (see Backups), and your Local Copy is now the newer world.
world-gdrive-sync.upload.title: Uploading Shared World…
world-gdrive-sync.upload.failed: Upload failed: %s. Unless someone Took Over, you still hold the Lock, so nobody else can start the world. Your progress is safe on this computer as a Pending Upload: it is retried the next time you start the game, or press Retry Upload on the Shared Worlds screen.
world-gdrive-sync.retry.failed: Upload failed again: %s. Your progress is still a Pending Upload on this computer.
world-gdrive-sync.sharedWorlds.pendingUp: Pending Upload: your progress isn't in Google Drive yet
world-gdrive-sync.backups.title: Backups of %s
world-gdrive-sync.backups.empty: No Backups yet. Each upload keeps the world it replaces as a Backup.
world-gdrive-sync.backups.locked: Someone holds the Lock, so restoring is refused until it's free.
world-gdrive-sync.backups.confirm.title: Restore This Backup?
world-gdrive-sync.backups.confirm: %s goes back to Revision %s, saved %s. The current world becomes a Backup, so you can undo this. Everyone downloads the restored world on their next Play.
world-gdrive-sync.restore.title: Restoring %s
world-gdrive-sync.restore.refused.title: Can't Restore Now
world-gdrive-sync.restore.refused: %s has a Lock held by %s: they're hosting it, or crashed while hosting and haven't saved yet. A restore could lose their progress, so it's only possible while nobody holds the Lock.
world-gdrive-sync.share.title: Share an Existing World
world-gdrive-sync.share.explain: The world is uploaded as a new Shared World. Your original stays in your Singleplayer list.
world-gdrive-sync.share.noWorlds: You have no singleplayer worlds to share.
world-gdrive-sync.share.worldOpen: Open in the game; close it first
world-gdrive-sync.settings.title: Shared Worlds Settings
world-gdrive-sync.settings.waitingForBro: Sign in to the shared Google account in your web browser, then come back here. If the browser didn't open, copy the link and paste it into your browser.
world-gdrive-sync.settings.clientMissing: This build of the mod has no Google OAuth client configured, so it can't connect.
world-gdrive-sync.settings.periodicUploa: While you host a Shared World, save it and upload it this often, so a crash loses at most this much progress. The world is always uploaded when you save and quit.
A Host whose game hasn't checked in for this long shows as Stale, and friends can Take Over.
